summary: Avalanche near Twin Lake/Independence Pass swept 7 skiers; 2 killed, 3 injured, 2 buried uninjured
location: Near Twin Lake, Independence Pass, ~11,000 ft
notes: 7 skiers caught; 2 killed, 3 injured, 2 buried but uninjured; MERGED duplicate id 2717 (run 510): its 2014-02-17 UN story is the same incident (slide ~5 p.m. Saturday 2014-02-15 on Star Mountain near Leadville; bodies of the two killed skiers found Sunday near the top of the slide, both wearing beacons; three others injured, non-life-threatening; third deadly CO avalanche slide that week). All 7 skiers swept: 2 killed, 3 injured, 2 buried uninjured.
